Friday 9/25, Heavy Squat 5x5 @ 250 lb — [evt-ai-1].

Flag: 250 for 5x5 is ~91% of your 275x3, which is very heavy for that rep scheme — realistic 5-rep max is likely closer to 245-250, so this is at the edge, not a comfortable "moderate hard" day. Warm-up built in: bar x10, 135x5, 185x3, 215x2, 235x1, then 5x5@250. If bar speed dies badly by set 3-4, cut to 3x5 and call it a PR-adjacent effort rather than grinding all 5.
